summary: Iter67 — Backend: 12/12 pytests pass for auto-dispatch (config GET/PUT admin-only with 403 for non-admin/anon, partial merge persisted in service_configs, stats endpoint shape OK, E2E loop test confirmed escalation increments tier counter after ~18s wait on a fresh pending ride created at Paris 48.857/2.347). Regression: /api/admin/stats, /api/admin/analytics, /api/auth/me all 200. Frontend: /admin renders WITHOUT 'Oops!' error boundary — LeafletMap now renders inside God's View card with 6 OSM tiles loaded. /admin/auto-dispatch container + all 13 required testids present (enabled-toggle, first/second/auto-cancel/radius inputs, first-palette-expert/confirme-btn, second-palette-standard-btn, save-config-btn, stat-tier-0/1/2/cancelled). Palette toggle flips class state correctly; save-config-btn returns 'Configuration enregistrée' sonner toast. /admin/live-rides still loads with admin-live-rides container. AutoDispatch loop confirmed in backend logs: 'AutoDispatch loop started' on boot + active cancellations of stale pending rides. All 3 iter67 features (b LeafletMap, c loop + c admin endpoints + c admin UI) PASS.

integration_issues.issue: Browser still logs 'WS error Event' on admin pages — /ws/{client_id} is still mounted outside /api prefix and not routed by ingress. Not part of iter67 scope but still unresolved.

action_items: (carryover from iter65) MOVE WebSocket route to /api/ws/{client_id} in server.py and update WS_URL builders in frontend so real-time new_ride_request / priority_ride_offer frames reach admins and drivers in production. Auto-dispatch will silently degrade to polling for drivers until this is fixed because `manager.send_personal_message` payloads cannot reach driver WS sessions via the public ingress.

(carryover from iter65) Renew expired REACT_APP_GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY in /app/frontend/.env — Google Maps widgets on other booking pages still throw ExpiredKeyMapError. God's View is fine now (uses Leaflet).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/auto_dispatch.py:194-197 — escalation chain uses elif so a ride aged >= second_escalation_seconds will jump from tier 0 straight to tier 2 in a single sweep (skipping tier 1). This is acceptable but means tier_1_priority stat can be undercounted vs reality when loop sweep interval (5s) is large relative to escalation gap. Document or split into sequential if blocks if accuracy of tier-1 counts matters.

routes/auto_dispatch.py:165 — auto_dispatch_loop has no shutdown guard; if cancelled mid-iteration it will log a CancelledError. Wrap the while True in `try/except asyncio.CancelledError: raise` to silence shutdown noise.

AdminAutoDispatch.js:42 — `save` sends the full cfg object (including stale `enabled`, all palettes). Fine, but on rapid double-clicks could overwrite values; consider debounce or disable Save during loading.

AdminAutoDispatch.js:60 — `parseInt(v) || 0` silently converts empty/invalid input to 0; risk of admin saving 0s for auto_cancel_after_seconds → instant ride cancellation. Add a min sane bound (e.g. 10s).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 13 testids + LeafletMap + toggle + save toast + regression routes all OK)

seed_data_creation: One TEST_iter67 pending ride created at Paris (48.857, 2.347) via /api/rides as neg_test user during E2E loop test; the auto-dispatch loop escalated it to tier 2 within ~18s (then config was restored).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter67 all features pass cleanly. Auto-dispatch admin page at /admin/auto-dispatch has full testid coverage. God's View card on /admin now uses LeafletMap (no more error boundary). Background loop logs 'AutoDispatch loop started' at boot and runs every 5s. Pre-existing carryover issues (unchanged): (a) /ws/{client_id} not reachable from public ingress — affects real-time priority_ride_offer notifications to drivers; falls back to polling. (b) Google Maps API key expired in frontend/.env. For E2E loop verification next time, lower escalation thresholds via PUT /api/admin/auto-dispatch/config to 5/15/300, create a ride, wait 18s, then check stats delta — that's how test_pending_ride_escalates_to_tier_1 works.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failing scenarios in iter67 scope. Carryover WS issue RCA documented in iter65 report.
